p: 'for the day is holy to our Lord;
for the joy of Hashem is your strength'"
Nevertheless, it is stated in the poskim
he may fast on Rosh Hashanah,
and there is even a mitzvah in this.
and answer, 'May His great Name be blessed,'
HaKadosh Baruch Hu shakes His head:
אַשְׁרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁמְּקַלְּסִין אוֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ כָּךְ,
'Fortunate is the King who is praised thus in His house!
מַה לּוֹ לָאָב שֶׁהִגְלָה אֶת בָּנָיו,
What is there for the Father who exiled His children,
who were exiled from their Father's table!'"
שֶׁבְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כְּשֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ אָז הַדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
on Rosh Hashanah, when they then heard the words of Torah
that there were claims against them,
although they did have dread and fear,
they also came from this to sadness.
"for the day is holy to our Lord":
brings fear and dread into the heart,
as this day is called in the Tikkunim
it should not bring you to sadness.
For Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
is named for laughter and joy,
and so it is in the holy Zohar
(מִדְרַשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם תּוֹלְדוֹת, חֵלֶק א קלה, א):
the offspring of laughter and joy," etc.
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁמִּדַּת יִצְחָק הוּא פַּחַד יִצְחָק,
That is, the attribute of Yitzchak is "the Fear of Yitzchak";
לֹא בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ
only so that they should fear Him,
'And God has made it so that they should fear Him.'"
(end of the sixth chapter of Avos, 6:11):
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
"Everything that HaKadosh Baruch Hu created in His world
He created only for His glory," etc.;
that is, that there be a revelation
of the glory of the kingship of Heaven.
"a king whose awe is upon you."
And when they accept the yoke of His kingship,
אָז יֵשׁ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׂמְחָה מִזֶּה,
then Hashem Yisbarach has joy from it,
for this was the purpose of Creation, as stated.
And from this joy sprouts forth for Yisrael too,
(תַּנָּא דְבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פֶּרֶק ג):
(Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu Rabbah, beginning of chapter 3):
"my joy is from within my fear."
And this is what he told them,
that the fear and dread should not bring them
"for the joy of Hashem is your strength";
for this, that Hashem Yisbarach rejoices
and in their acceptance of His kingship upon themselves,
since through this He will bring joy
שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל עוֹנִין יְהֵא שְׁמוֹ הַגָּדוֹל מְבֹרָךְ וְכוּלֵּי,
that Yisrael answer "May His great Name be blessed," etc.,
He says, "Fortunate is the King," etc.,
and "What is there for the Father,"
and "woe to the children who were exiled."
Therefore now, at a time of Churban,
it is permitted to fast as well.
הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שָׂמֵחַ בְּקַבָּלַת עֹל מַלְכוּתוֹ
Hashem Yisbarach rejoices in the acceptance of the yoke of His kingship
שֶׁכָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַבְּלִין עֲלֵיהֶם בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
that all Yisrael take upon themselves on Rosh Hashanah,
and "the joy of Hashem is your strength" —
that were made known to them."
That is, the words entered their hearts,
for "understood" is related to "Binah is the heart"
וְהִכְנִיס בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי זֶה גַּם הַדַּעַת,
and through this it brought da'as into them as well,
and it was "my joy from within my fear."
And the joy that comes through fear
